text: {"memo": "Adobe Inc. (ADBE) delivered another strong fiscal year in FY2024, ending May 31, 2024, with revenue of roughly $20.0\u202fbillion, up about 14% from $17.6\u202fbillion in FY2023 and roughly 29% from $15.5\u202fbillion in FY2022. The company generated net income of approximately $5.0\u202fbillion, yielding a net margin near 25%, and reported earnings per share of $13.50, up from $11.20 in FY2023 and $9.00 in FY2022. Operating cash flow was about $5.5\u202fbillion in FY2024, providing free cash flow of roughly $3.2\u202fbillion after capital expenditures of $2.3\u202fbillion. Gross margin remained robust at around 80%, while operating margin improved to about 35%. The growth trajectory was driven by strong performance in its Creative Cloud subscription business, which added over 1\u202fmillion paid seats, and by expanding offerings in Document Cloud and marketing cloud. The prior two years showed consistent double\u2011digit revenue growth and margin expansion, underscoring Adobe\u2019s scalable, high\u2011margin model. The stock trades at a premium multiple reflecting its recurring revenue base, but the pace of earnings acceleration has moderated as the market becomes more competitive. Overall, Adobe remains a high\u2011quality software franchise with solid cash generation and a clear strategic roadmap."}
